name: Oklahoma
dueDateNotes: Oklahoma follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Oklahoma applies graduated rates topping out at 4.75% (2025) to your federal AGI after the standard deduction ($6,350 single / $12,700 joint) and a $1,000 personal exemption per person. For 2026 Oklahoma moves to three brackets with a 4.5% top rate, which this page does not yet reflect.
uniqueFacts: Oklahoma's brackets are not adjusted for inflation, and most self-employment income lands in the top 4.75% bracket, which starts at just $7,200 (single) / $14,400 (joint) for 2025.
Oklahoma gives a $6,350 standard deduction (single) or $12,700 (joint), plus a $1,000 personal exemption per person.
For 2026, Oklahoma collapses to three brackets with a lower 4.5% top rate under HB 2764; this page uses the 2025 schedule.
